title: Profile People
subtitle: Portrait studies made while I was reading about Constructivism and Cubism.
seo_title: Profile People: Constructivist Geometric Portraits with Sharp Angles
seo_description: A generative portrait series focusing on geometric head and shoulder profiles with constructivist and cubist cues, sharp angles, and vibrant color fields
thumb_alt: Angular geometric portraits with bold color blocks and sharp constructivist forms

media_alt: Geometric profile portraits of head and shoulders with constructivist, cubist inspired sharp angles and vibrant color fields
challenge: Constructivist and Cubist portraiture taught painters to stop copying a face and start building one — out of planes, color blocks, and decisions. I wanted to see if I could learn to think that way about a portrait myself.
approach: I read into both movements, then drafted profile after profile, watching for the ones where the face was clearly a construction but still felt like a person. I kept the ones that taught me something and that I personally liked.
result: Six angular, color-blocked profiles that I'm fond of. They're available as prints for anyone who enjoys that kind of geometric portraiture.
